---
title: "Data Preprocessing"
output: html_document
---

First, load the dataset

First set: [OWID](https://docs.owid.io/projects/etl/api/covid/#download-data)
Second set: [HDI, Table 2](https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/documentation-and-downloads)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

COVID <- read.csv("data/compact.csv")
HDI <- read.csv("data/hdi_composite.csv", fileEncoding = "Windows-1252")
```

Then, split the dataset by the 2020 and 2021 dates used in the paper. This is the Covid_2020 and Covid_2021 variables. 

```{r}
COVID$date <- as.Date(COVID$date)

cases_2020 <- COVID %>%
  filter(date == as.Date("2020-12-31")) %>% #paper uses 12/31/2020
  select(country, total_cases_per_million) %>%
  rename(CASES_2020 = total_cases_per_million)


cases_2021 <- COVID %>%
  filter(date == as.Date("2021-12-30")) %>% #paper uses 12/31/2021
  select(country, total_cases_per_million) %>%
  rename(CASES_2021 = total_cases_per_million)

covid_cases <- inner_join(cases_2020, cases_2021, by = "country")


# le_2020    = life expectancy
# eys_2020   = expected years of schooling
# mys_2020   = mean years of schooling
# gnipc_2020 = gross national income per capita

hdi_2020 <- HDI %>%
  select(country,
    LIFE_EXP = le_2020,
    EXP_SCHOOLING = eys_2020,
    MEAN_SCHOOLING = mys_2020,
    GNI = gnipc_2020
  )

```

Align the country names and combine the datasets.

```{r}
#aligning country names

hdi_2020 <- hdi_2020 %>%
  mutate(
    country = case_when(
      country == "Bolivia (Plurinational State of)" ~ "Bolivia",
      country == "Brunei Darussalam" ~ "Brunei",
      country == "Cabo Verde" ~ "Cape Verde",
      country == "Congo (Democratic Republic of the)" ~ "Democratic Republic of Congo",
      country == "Côte d'Ivoire" ~ "Cote d'Ivoire",
      country == "Eswatini (Kingdom of)" ~ "Eswatini",
      country == "Hong Kong, China (SAR)" ~ "Hong Kong",
      country == "Iran (Islamic Republic of)" ~ "Iran",
      country == "Korea (Democratic People's Rep. of)" ~ "North Korea",
      country == "Korea (Republic of)" ~ "South Korea",
      country == "Lao People's Democratic Republic" ~ "Laos",
      country == "Micronesia (Federated States of)" ~ "Micronesia (country)",
      country == "Moldova (Republic of)" ~ "Moldova",
      country == "Palestine, State of" ~ "Palestine",
      country == "Russian Federation" ~ "Russia",
      country == "Syrian Arab Republic" ~ "Syria",
      country == "Tanzania (United Republic of)" ~ "Tanzania",
      country == "Timor-Leste" ~ "East Timor",
      country == "Türkiye" ~ "Turkey",
      country == "Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of)" ~ "Venezuela",
      country == "Viet Nam" ~ "Vietnam",
      TRUE ~ country
    )
  )
```

Clean up the data for use and split into train/test/validaton

```{r}
final_data <- inner_join(covid_cases, hdi_2020, by = "country")
#final cleanup
final_data <- final_data %>%
  drop_na(CASES_2020, CASES_2021, LIFE_EXP, EXP_SCHOOLING, MEAN_SCHOOLING, GNI)

final_data <- final_data %>%
  select(country, LIFE_EXP, EXP_SCHOOLING, MEAN_SCHOOLING, GNI, CASES_2020, CASES_2021)

final_data <- final_data %>%
  filter(CASES_2020 > 0)

#split dataset 70/20/10

set.seed(340)

n <- nrow(final_data)
shuffled_indices <- sample(n)

train_size <- floor(0.70 * n)
valid_size <- floor(0.20 * n)

train_idx <- shuffled_indices[1:train_size]
valid_idx <- shuffled_indices[(train_size + 1):(train_size + valid_size)]
test_idx  <- shuffled_indices[(train_size + valid_size + 1):n]

# 5. Create the subsets
train_data <- COVID[train_idx, ]
valid_data <- COVID[valid_idx, ]
test_data  <- COVID[test_idx, ]

# 6. Save each subset back to a new CSV file
write.csv(train_data, "train_set.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(valid_data, "valid_set.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(test_data,  "test_set.csv",  row.names = FALSE)
```
